3. Use quality cheese: A good pizza needs high quality cheese. The cheese should be fresh and melted, but not burned.
4. Use the best tomato sauce: A good tomato sauce can make a pizza. Look for a sauce without preservatives or artificial flavours and with plenty of fresh, ripe tomatoes.
